name: @guardbee/mcp-vector-store-scanner
description: MCP server that probes vector-database endpoints (Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Redis, Postgres/pgvector) for unauthenticated exposure of embeddings and RAG data
long_description: Probes a vector-database or vector-index-capable endpoint for unauthenticated access. Fingerprints the endpoint (Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch via HTTP; Redis via the raw RESP protocol; Postgres/pgvector via the raw wire-protocol SSLRequest+StartupMessage handshake) and escalates through progressively more sensitive checks — instance info, then schema/collection listing, then actual stored data — stopping to report the most severe unauthenticated finding at each level. Every check is a read-only probe; no real credentials or write operations are ever sent. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
